An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"https://example.com/inner\">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
